scripts.hub:up: node hub/scripts/init-broker.mjs && docker compose -f hub/docker-compose.yml up -d --force-recreate
scripts.pilot:up: node hub/scripts/init-broker.mjs --prod && docker compose -f hub/docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --build
scripts.pilot:backup: docker compose -f hub/docker-compose.prod.yml exec backend pnpm exec tsx src/backup-cli.ts
